opening.argument: The speaker actively demonstrates buying into an ICO, saying, “we're going to try to buy here the button to buy ICO buy now.” He presents the transaction as attractive by emphasizing that “with the bonus and cloud you will get 55 that's great,” describing 55 tokens for a 50-token purchase and a purported 10% bonus. He then directs viewers to copy the payment information and send cryptocurrency from a wallet: “please excite amount of ptc, so i'm gonna to copy this go to my wallet and send.” Finally, he invites participation and provides links, stating, “if you wanna join or be in this ico there is link below also there is this link of other ICO's in the description.” These are direct purchase instructions and solicitation for token participation, not neutral reporting.
